inputs.label: Set maximal display precision in decimal points: 1

notes: In this calculator, mcg is the abbreviation for micrograms.

To make simple dose conversions, select the starting medication with the pull-down selector on the right. Then type a starting dose in the top FROM input box. To convert the dose, choose the new medication in the lower right selector. The converted dose will appear immediately in the TO box.
This calculator offers approximate equipotent dose conversions based on published medical literature.
There is no exact agreement on conversion standards for dose equivalents, so titration to clinical response is essential when converting patient medications.
This calculator uses a conversion factor of 1 mg Dessicated Thyroid to 1.6667 mcg Levothyroxine. Previous versions had a 1:1 ratio.
Thyroid medication is sometimes dosed in grains. One grain is approximately 60-65 mg.
content.data_input_disclaimer: ONLY DIGITS 0 TO 9 AND A SINGLE DECIMAL POINT (".") ARE ACCEPTABLE AS NUMERIC INPUTS. ATTEMPTED INPUT OF OTHER CHARACTERS INTO A NUMERIC FIELD MAY LEAD TO AN INCORRECT RESULT.
